podcast.body: Walker wrote this song in 1968, which was later covered by the Nitty Gritty Dirt Band. He met the inspiration for "Bojangles" in a New Orleans jail after being arrested for public disturbance while drunk; the actual man's name was not Bojangles, but the moniker derived from the African American dancer Bill Bojangles Robinson. "Walter Bojangles was a real guy who Walker met in a jail in New Orleans after he was arrested for making a public disturbance while drunk."
